title: Amy Zhang - Identifying Exceptional Potential
summary:
Amy is Executive
Vice President and Portfolio Manager of the Alger Small Cap Focus,
Alger Mid Cap Focus, Alger Mid Cap 40, and Alger Small Cap Growth
Strategies. She joined Alger in 2015 and has 27 years of investment
experience, including over a decade at Brown Capital Management as
a Partner, Managing Director, and Senior Portfolio Manager of its
Brown Capital Small Company Strategy. Amy has received multiple accolades, including being named one
of the "Best Female PMs to Invest with Now" by Morningstar in 2022
and one of the “Top 20 Female Portfolio Managers” by Citywire in
2021, 2019, and 2018.
